integrity: The self-contained analytic proof is distinguished from a finite exact-arithmetic coefficient checker. No external independent review, formal proof, or exhaustive prior-art clearance is represented.
scientific_limitations: Escape and asymptotics are proved for an explicitly forward-invariant nonempty open wedge, not for the whole phase plane or all unbounded orbits. Error terms are orbitwise. Earlier global-center classifications are credited; the full 1999 near-infinity source was not available for inspection, and absolute novelty is not claimed.
title: Universal two-term finite-time escape in polynomial nilpotent Liénard systems
